description: Simple passphrase-based authentication with persistent sessions and parent/kid role scoping. Passphrases set by Eric (admin) and distributed via 1Password. Parents see everything; kids see only their linked accounts. Replaces the current localStorage member picker with server-enforced identity.

timing.gatingCondition: Feature 7 complete. Prerequisite for Feature 6 (Kids View).

principles: Auth should be invisible day-to-day — 30-day sessions, no constant re-login
Passphrases set by admin (Eric) and pushed via 1Password — no self-service password flow
Two roles only: parent (full access) and kid (scoped access) — no RBAC complexity
Server-side enforcement — role checks in middleware, not UI hiding
SECRETS INVARIANT — passphrase hashes never appear in API responses, logs, or client code

techStack.crypto: Node built-in crypto.scryptSync for hashing, crypto.randomUUID for session tokens
techStack.testing: node:test for auth logic, middleware, and role scoping

userStories.title: Passphrase hashing and session management
acceptanceCriteria: lib/auth.js: hashPassphrase(plain) → scrypt hash with random salt
lib/auth.js: verifyPassphrase(plain, hash) → boolean
lib/auth.js: createSession(memberId) → generates crypto.randomUUID token, stores in sessions table with 30-day expiry
lib/auth.js: validateSession(token) → returns member record or null
lib/auth.js: destroySession(token) → deletes from sessions table
Expired sessions cleaned up periodically (daily cron or on-access)
userStories.testStrategy: Unit tests: hash round-trip, session create/validate/expire/destroy. Verify passphrase_hash never returned from any query.

userStories.title: Auth middleware and role enforcement
acceptanceCriteria: Express middleware reads session token from HttpOnly cookie (fp_session)
Valid session: attaches req.member (id, name, role) to request
Invalid/missing session: returns 401 JSON for API routes
GET requests to static files and /api/health bypass auth
POST /api/auth/login and GET /login.html bypass auth
Role middleware: requireParent() rejects kid role with 403
Admin routes (settings, link, import) require parent role
Kid-accessible routes: dashboard (scoped), transactions (scoped), budget (scoped)
userStories.testStrategy: Middleware unit tests: valid session, expired session, missing cookie, parent-only route with kid session. Integration test for full request cycle.

userStories.title: Auth API routes
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/auth/login — accepts { member_id, passphrase }, returns session cookie + member info
POST /api/auth/logout — clears session cookie, destroys session in DB
GET /api/auth/me — returns current authenticated member (id, name, role, avatar_emoji)
PUT /api/auth/passphrase — parent-only, sets passphrase for any member (admin distributes via 1Password)
Login route returns 401 on wrong passphrase, no timing information leakage
Members without a passphrase_hash cannot log in (setup required first)
userStories.testStrategy: API tests: successful login, wrong passphrase, missing passphrase, logout clears session, /me returns correct member, passphrase set by parent only.

userStories.title: Login page UI
acceptanceCriteria: public/login.html — standalone page, same dark theme and emerald accent
Member picker: shows family member buttons (avatar + name)
Passphrase input field with submit
Error message on failed login
On success: redirect to index.html (dashboard)
If already authenticated (valid session), skip login and go to dashboard
userStories.testStrategy: Manual UI testing. Verify redirect on valid session. Verify error display on bad passphrase.

userStories.title: Frontend auth integration
acceptanceCriteria: Remove localStorage fp_member usage — identity comes from session
app.js: on load, call GET /api/auth/me to get current member
If 401: redirect to login.html
Remove member picker overlay — member is set by login, not manual selection
Parents get 'Switch user' option (logout + re-login) in nav/settings
All api() fetch calls: 401 response triggers redirect to login
Kid role: hide nav links to settings, admin, import, link pages
userStories.testStrategy: Manual UI testing across member roles. Verify kids cannot navigate to restricted pages.

userStories.title: Data scoping for kid role
acceptanceCriteria: account_members join table: links accounts to family members
Parent setup UI in settings: assign accounts to kids
API queries for kid role automatically filter to their linked accounts only
Kid cannot see other members' transactions, balances, or budget data
Kid cannot access anomaly detection, magic actions, or admin features
Scoping enforced at query level, not UI level
userStories.testStrategy: Unit tests: kid query returns only linked account data. Integration test: kid session cannot access parent account data. Verify no cross-account leakage.

high: Passphrase hashes must never appear in API responses or logs — extend secrets-guard to cover passphrase_hash column
medium: Session cookie security: HttpOnly + SameSite=Strict. No Secure flag needed (Tailscale, no public internet)
Migration must handle existing family_members rows gracefully — passphrase_hash starts NULL, login disabled until set
low: 30-day session expiry may be annoying on rarely-used devices — configurable via app_config if needed

preFlightChecklist: Confirm: no self-service password set/reset — Eric sets all passphrases and pushes via 1Password
Confirm: two roles only (parent, kid) — no guest or read-only role
Confirm: kids see only linked accounts (account_members mapping set by parent in settings)
